_about: Demo mode script (ui/demo.py). An invented product meeting; every person and product here is made up. Times are seconds from the start at speed 1 (about 5 minutes). A 'say' line appears 'dur' seconds after its 't', plus the usual transcription delay, and only while recording is on.
title: Orbit 2.0 launch sync

events.text: yes
Yes!
yes please
Okay, looks like we're all here. Thanks for jumping on, this is the weekly launch sync for Orbit 2.0.
Quick agenda: where the beta stands, the launch date, and what we still need from design before we submit.
Sure. Beta has been out to about four hundred testers since Thursday, and crash-free sessions are at ninety-nine point one percent.
Most of the feedback is positive. People like the new home screen and the faster search.
Nice, that's better than the last beta. Anything blocking?

summary.text: Beta 2.0 is with about 400 testers since Thursday: 99.1% crash-free sessions, feedback mostly positive (new home screen, faster search).

events.text: One thing, and it's a real one. When the phone goes offline and comes back, the sync queue can replay the same edit twice. About two percent of testers got duplicated notes.
Oh, that explains the screenshots in the feedback channel. People thought it was a display bug.
It's not display, it's the reconnect logic. I know where it is, but the fix touches the storage layer, so I want a proper test pass.

summary.text: Sync bug: after going offline and back, the sync queue can replay an edit twice (duplicated notes for about 2% of testers). The fix touches the storage layer.

events.text: How long are we talking? Our date is December second, and we need a couple of days for App Store review.
The fix itself is two days. Then I'd want the beta to run on it for at least three days before we submit.
From the design side we're mostly done. The only open piece is onboarding for the sync status icon.
If sync is changing anyway, I'd like a small synced and waiting-to-sync state, so people trust it again.
I like that. Daniel, does the status icon need anything from you?
Just the three states from the sync service. I can expose those in the same fix, it's the same code.

summary.text: Design is mostly done. Priya proposes 'synced' and 'waiting to sync' states in onboarding; Daniel can expose them in the same fix.

events.text: Okay. If I add that up, two days for the fix, three days of beta, two days of review... December second is very tight.
It's not realistic, honestly.

summary.text: The December 2 launch looks unrealistic: 2 days of fixing, 3 days of beta and 2 days of App Store review.

events.text: Let's not ship a sync bug in a release that's literally about sync. Hold on, I think Leo is joining.
Hey Leo, we were just talking about the date.
yes
Hi everyone, sorry I'm late, I was in the campaign review. Did I miss anything about the date?
Perfect timing actually. We found a sync bug in beta. Daniel needs about a week to fix and test it, so December second doesn't work anymore.
Okay. What's the new date? The email campaign and the blog post are scheduled for the second.
Proposal: we move launch to Tuesday, December ninth. Same weekday, so your schedule just shifts by a week.
That works for me. Tuesday is still our best day for email. I'll just need the final screenshots by the fourth.
December ninth is fine for engineering.
Works for design. Screenshots by the fourth is doable.
Great, then that's decided. Launch moves to December ninth.

summary.text: Launch moves from December 2 to Tuesday, December 9. The email campaign and blog post shift by a week; final screenshots are due December 4.

events.text: Let's make the follow-ups concrete. Daniel, you'll own the sync fix, including the three status states?
Yes. The fix and the status states will be in the beta build by Friday, so testers get the weekend on it.

action.text: Ship the offline-sync fix, with the three sync status states, in the beta build

events.text: Priya, the onboarding update for the sync status. Can you have mockups by Wednesday?
Wednesday works. I'll share them in the design channel and tag Daniel for the states.

action.text: Share onboarding mockups for the sync status indicator in the design channel

events.text: And I'll move the campaign dates on my side, nothing needed from you all.
Perfect. Last thing from me: I'll update the launch doc and let support know about the new date.
One small ask: can we keep the beta feedback form open until we submit? It's been super useful.
Yes, let's keep it open.

summary.text: Maya updates the launch doc and tells support about the new date. The beta feedback form stays open until submission.

events.text: Also, the new home screen got a lot of love in the feedback. Nice work, Daniel.
Thanks, it was a team effort.
Okay, I think that's everything. Thanks everyone, same time next week.
Thanks, bye!
Bye, everyone.
